children: Connect Biopharma reported Phase 2 topline: rademikibart gave a 130 mL greater FEV1 increase vs placebo at Day 7 and a 66% reduction in 28-day treatment failures (not statistically significant for primary endpoint).
Phase 2 Seabreeze STAT Asthma (n=160) tested single 600 mg SC rademikibart vs placebo as add-on for acute exacerbations.
Key secondary: post-bronchodilator FEV1 improved 250 mL (rademikibart) vs 120 mL (placebo); Δ130 mL, p=0.023 (Day 7).
Rademikibart reduced 28-day treatment failure rate by ~66% (2.5% vs 7.4%); endpoint missed statistical significance (p=0.153) due to lower-than-expected event rate.
50% fewer ED or unscheduled medical visits for worsening asthma vs placebo; potential to reduce near-term healthcare utilization.
Favorable tolerability: low incidence of AEs, comparable safety to placebo; 1 SAE in rademikibart arm vs 3 in placebo arm.
